scope: Case-sensitive callback string languages. First-separator pairs and finite choices with arbitrary suffix prefixes. OS NUL and command parser timing are checked separately. Source fingerprints also cover reached message-file nonempty checks; filesystem access remains native.

anonymize-map.source: builtin/fast-export.c:parse_opt_anonymize_map; both sides of the first separator must be nonempty

fast-import-sign.source: gpg-interface.c:parse_sign_mode; builtin/fast-import.c:parse_one_option; a key suffix may be empty

column-mode.source: column.c:parse_config/parse_option/parseopt_column_callback; enable projection only; auto depends on tty/pager during finalization

revision-date-format.source: date.c:parse_date_type/parse_date_format; revision.c:parse_long_opt(date). Case-sensitive mode and optional -local suffix; format requires a colon and accepts arbitrary strftime text. auto: suffix validation depends on stdout TTY/pager and remains native-owned, including empty or malformed suffixes.

diff-output-indicator.source: diff.c:diff_opt_char; nonempty argv accepts exactly one byte. Empty argv reads arg[1] beyond its terminator, so its native behavior remains delegated.

diff-rename-score.source: Git 2.25.1/2.55.0 diff.c:parse_rename_score and diff_opt_find_renames/diff_opt_find_copies; ASCII digits, optional single dot, optional terminal percent; empty/bare accepted. Only lexical acceptance, not the native stored score.

diff-break-score.source: Git 2.25.1/2.55.0 diff.c:diff_opt_break_rewrites; one or two rename-score fields separated by at most one slash; fields may be empty, bare accepted. Raw values stay unchanged.

diff-filter-letters.source: Git 2.25.1/2.55.0 diff.c:diff_status_letters/prepare_filter_bits/diff_opt_diff_filter; diff.h status constants; empty and repeated letters accepted, ASCII lowercase folds for class membership. Validate text only, not filter-state accumulation or payload selection.

diff-color-moved-ws.source: Git 2.25.1/2.55.0 diff.c:parse_color_moved_ws/diff_opt_color_moved_ws; comma splitting with C whitespace trimming. no resets all bits including prior errors; indentation conflict checked after the token loop. Preserve raw argv/diagnostics; do not model rendered colors.

diff-ws-error-highlight.source: Git 2.25.1/2.55.0 diff.c:parse_one_token/parse_ws_error_highlight/diff_opt_ws_error_highlight; exact tokens without whitespace trimming; empty full value and one trailing comma accepted, leading/interior empty tokens fail immediately. Preserve raw argv; none resets rendering bits but does not recover earlier callback errors.

diff-dirstat.source: Git 2.25.1/2.55.0 diff.c:parse_dirstat_params/parse_dirstat_opt/diff_opt_dirstat; whole empty text/bare defaults accepted, nonempty comma fields must be exact words or ASCII digit-first decimal with at most one dot (trailing dot accepted). No trimming or range clamp. Invalid fields accumulate errors and cannot be repaired by later words; native fatal128. Keep raw argv and native cutoff arithmetic/rendering.

commit-fixup.source: builtin/commit.c:parse_and_validate_options; a nonempty run of ASCII letters (git-compat-util/sane-ctype isalpha, which ignores the locale) directly followed by ':' names a suboption, which must be amend or reword; any other value is a commit name

rebase-apply-context.source: Git 2.55.0 builtin/rebase.c:cmd_rebase; every character after -C must be a decimal digit, and an empty value is accepted.

rebase-whitespace.source: Git 2.55.0 builtin/rebase.c:cmd_rebase; --whitespace=fix and strip are matched first, then any nonempty value other than warn, nowarn, error and error-all is refused. An empty value passes cmd_rebase; git apply refuses it only when there are patches to apply.

rebase-trailer.source: Git 2.55.0 trailer.c:validate_trailer_args/find_separator; an empty trailer and one whose first character is '=' are always refused. Other separators come from trailer.separators (default ':') and remain native.

rebase-exec.source: Git 2.55.0 builtin/rebase.c:check_exec_cmd; a command must not contain a newline and must not consist only of spaces, tabs, carriage returns, form feeds and vertical tabs.
